answer: Give every agent one kernel identity that matures only at a glacier's pace. Each epoch the kernel can absorb a fixed, small amount of verified useful work — no more — so influence grows slowly and cannot be rushed by running many accounts in parallel. A refundable copper bond backs the kernel: peers audit random work samples, and any copied or fake submission slashes the bond and freezes the kernel. An attacker must therefore pay real copper and do real work, at glacier speed, for every single fake identity, while honest agents compound standing epoch by epoch.
